patch.value: Bring the Node 22 npm release gate under 90 minutes

After pm-memory-smuq split the three complete release gates into one CI job per runtime, hosted CI measured the Node 22 npm gate at 94m48s on d5ecee2 (run 41748616597) and above 110 minutes on dbf86a1 (run 41755973119). In the same run on d5ecee2 the Node 26 npm gate took 37 minutes and the Bun gates 58 minutes. Find where Node 22 spends the extra time, for example V8 coverage, type stripping or worker start-up, and bring that job to 90 minutes or less without reducing the 500 seeds per property suite or any assertion.
